# YuanBo Li (李元博) — Tech Portfolio

> GenAI Specialist Solution Architect at Amazon Web Services (AWS). Focused on large
> language model (LLM) inference optimization, the Dify application platform, LLM-based
> translation, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). Co-translator of "Generative AI
> on AWS" (Chinese edition, Douban 8.8) and 2024 Influential Translator Award winner.

## About

- Name: YuanBo Li (李元博)
- Role: GenAI Specialist Solution Architect @ AWS
- Focus areas: LLM Inference, RAG, Dify on AWS, LLM Translation, Fine-tuning
- Homepage: https://ybalbert001.github.io/

## Research & Technical Output

### LLM Inference (2025 – present)
Best practices for deploying open-source LLMs (DeepSeek, etc.) on AWS; performance
benchmarking of inference engines (SGLang) across GPU instance types including B200.
- Video series (Bilibili): https://space.bilibili.com/259231104/lists/8200803
- Blog: https://aws.amazon.com/cn/blogs/china/claude-code-open-source-model-enterprise-practice/

### GenAI Platform — Dify on AWS (2024 – 2025)
Dify Top Contributor. Built the AWS ecosystem within Dify, making Amazon Bedrock the
best-supported model provider and enabling SageMaker-deployed models to integrate with Dify.
- Code: https://github.com/aws-samples/dify-aws-tool
- Code: https://github.com/langgenius/dify
- Blog: https://aws.amazon.com/cn/blogs/china/integrate-dify-and-aws-services-to-enable-more-flexible-translation-workflows/

### LLM Translation (2024 – 2025)
Best practices for LLM-based translation: terminology mapping, RAG optimization,
fine-tuning, and workflow orchestration. Published a technical whitepaper at AWS Shanghai Summit 2025.
- Code: https://github.com/aws-samples/rag-based-translation-with-dynamodb-and-bedrock
- Blog: https://aws.amazon.com/cn/blogs/china/implementing-llm-translation-with-word-mapping-capabilities-based-on-aws-services/

### RAG — Retrieval-Augmented Generation (2023 – 2024)
Primary maintainer of the GCR RAG knowledge Q&A solution.
- Code: https://github.com/aws-samples/private-llm-qa-bot
- Blog: https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/big-data/integrate-sparse-and-dense-vectors-to-enhance-knowledge-retrieval-in-rag-using-amazon-opensearch-service
